clause.quote: A given AID MUST NOT appear more than once in any Backer list.

inferred_from.inference: The sentence constrains a backer list's value; no validator-facing sentence names a repeated backer. That a validator should not accept an event whose backer list repeats an AID is inferred and graded SHOULD (docs/design.md, Principles: an obligation the specification states only for producers is graded SHOULD for validators), and the gap is raised in generators/SPEC-ISSUES.md (K-I5).

description: An inception whose witness list names the same witness twice, with witness threshold 2, carrying the witness's signature at both indexes. Line 353 forbids an AID appearing more than once in a backer list; a validator that accepted it would let one witness meet a threshold of two.
title: Inception listing one witness twice
